The '''Terephon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terephon]]. It was near this system that [[Isolder]]'s older brother [[Kalen (Hapan)|Kalen]] was captured and murdered by privateers. The system was the junction of the [[Great Rim Route]] and [[Hapan Spine]] hyperlanes.
